title: Package Knowledge Database
description: Structured knowledge about Android packages for debloat and package intelligence workflows.

category.description: High-level package category such as system, ui, app, messaging, tools, browser, store

oem.description: Vendor or manufacturer identifier, such as android, google, vivo, samsung

preinstalled.description: Whether the package is commonly preinstalled or factory-installed

recommendation.description: The recommended debloat bucket for the package

confidence.description: Confidence level for the knowledge entry

reason.description: Short explanation of why the package is classified this way
